This advancement significantly reduces water consumption and contributes to the Company’s broader sustainability and resource conservation objectives.
This practice conserves water at operational facilities and contributes to a meaningful reduction in fresh water withdrawal.

Key measures include the deployment of star-rated equipment, energy-efficient air conditioning systems, and LED lighting across office premises. In addition, JPL has implemented rooftop solar installations at several locations, including Patna, Noida, Agra, Varanasi, Lucknow, and Kanpur.

The adoption of energy efficient air conditioning systems and LED lighting supports ongoing energy conservation efforts, while the integration of renewable energy sources further strengthens the Company’s commitment to sustainable operations.
